race.comment: GOODNESS (12) resumes for her second campaign having shown good ability in three runs last time in, beaten under a length on debut at Bendigo then a head at Caulfield Heath. Kicks off at a lovely trip and should be very hard to beat. SILKY SETH (7) has placed in his past two starts, boxing on well for second behind a dominant winner at Geelong last time. Expecting that form to hold up strongly, takes catching. ANGLING ANGEL (9) didn't do much fresh at Pakenham Synthetic but was $3 there and might be a sharp improver onto turf. ROUGH ENUFF (6) Encouraging first-up run when runner-up at Seymour over 1200m on October 11. Draws ideally second up and can contest.
